title: Top 10 Essential Places to Visit in Punjab - Complete Guide
summary: Discover the ultimate travel spots in Punjab, from historic structures to scenic natural hideaways that you simply cannot miss.
content: Exploring Punjab is like walking through a living history book. With its diverse terrain, colorful markets, and centuries-old culture, there's an adventure waiting at every corner. In this curated guide, we break down the top must-visit landmarks including Amritsar Golden Temple, Patiala Qila Mubarak, Jalandhar Devi Talab, and more, detailing the best routes, local guides, and timing details to ensure your travel diary is packed with highlights.
